title: Prawn Bisque
description: A classic French-style prawn bisque made with a rich homemade prawn stock, aromatic vegetables, cream, and finished with perfectly seared prawns. Smooth, velvety, and full of deep seafood flavor.

ingredients.title: For the Prawn Stock
items: Prawn heads & shells (from large prawns) – 600 g
Fish or light seafood stock (unsalted preferred) – 1 L

ingredients.title: For the Bisque Base
items: Ripe tomatoes – 2 medium, peeled and chopped (or 150 g crushed canned tomatoes)
Salt and white pepper – to taste
Cayenne or Espelette pepper – a pinch (optional)

ingredients.title: For the Garnish
items: Prawn meat (tails), cleaned and deveined – 200 g
Chives or dill, finely chopped – for garnish

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Prawn Stock
steps: Heat olive oil in a large heavy saucepan.
Add prawn heads and shells; roast over medium-high heat until pink and aromatic (about 5–7 minutes).
Add onion, carrot, leek, and garlic; sauté 3–4 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste and cook 2 minutes to caramelize.
Deglaze with brandy—carefully ignite if desired to burn off alcohol.
Add white wine and reduce by half.
Add stock, thyme, bay leaf, and peppercorns.
Simmer gently for 30–40 minutes, skimming any foam.
Strain through a fine chinois, pressing well to extract flavor. Discard solids.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Make the Bisque Base
steps: In a clean pot, melt butter. Add shallot, carrot, and celery; sweat gently without browning (6–8 minutes).
Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute to make a light roux.
Add chopped tomatoes and the hot prawn stock gradually, stirring to avoid lumps.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes until thickened and flavors meld.
Blend until smooth (use a high-speed blender for a velvety texture).
Strain again through a fine sieve for a restaurant-smooth finish.
Return to the pot, add cream, and season with salt, white pepper, and cayenne.
Adjust acidity with lemon juice just before serving.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare the Garnish
steps: Heat butter and olive oil in a sauté pan.
Sear prawns for 1–2 minutes per side until just cooked.
Season lightly.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Serve
steps: Ladle hot bisque into warmed bowls.
Arrange prawns in the center.
Drizzle a touch of cream or herb oil on top.
Finish with micro-chives or dill.

chefTips: Depth of flavor: Roast shells well; don't rush the stock.
Texture: The double-straining step gives that signature silky French bisque finish.
Umami lift: A few drops of shellfish reduction or a dab of butter right before service enriches the mouthfeel.
